raw_text:
The user was involved with BCA-department communication concerning a student website-building and presentation activity.

Evidence: Students were instructed to “build websites at home,” bring them the next day, April 8, at 12 p.m., and present them to a judge. Date: 2024-04-07.

The user is pursuing MCA after BCA and working as a backend developer intern at Instaplex.

Evidence: User said “I am a student of MCA,” “I am about to finished BCA now doing MCA,” and “a backend developer at instaplex as intern.” Date: 2026-08-13.

The user's longer-term plans include a web-development career, financial independence as soon as possible, and wildlife photography.
